films.title: Dream Scenario
films.overview: Hapless family man Paul Matthews finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. But when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, Paul is forced to navigate his newfound stardom.

films.title: The Drama
films.overview: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

films.title: Sick of Myself
films.overview: Increasingly overshadowed by her boyfriend's recent rise to fame as a contemporary artist creating sculptures from stolen furniture, Signe hatches a vicious plan to reclaim her rightfully deserved attention within the milieu of Oslo's cultural elite.
